One AI model that can operate across your entire software stack without custom API integrations for each tool — that is no longer a roadmap slide. It is shipping now.

OpenAI has released GPT-6 "Astra," already rolling out to enterprise customers through ChatGPT Enterprise, Azure OpenAI, and AWS Bedrock. The defining capability: Astra can interact natively with familiar software and web applications without requiring a separate API for each one.

For CTOs, this changes the integration calculus entirely. The cost and complexity of connecting AI to every business tool has been one of the largest friction points in enterprise adoption. If a single model can navigate your CRM, your project management suite, your analytics dashboards, and your internal tools — the middleware layer that companies have spent millions building starts to look like technical debt.

For CEOs, the strategic question shifts from "which processes can we automate" to "which workflows still justify human-only execution." The companies that move fastest to restructure operations around this capability will compress months of integration work into days.

This is the inflection point where AI stops being a feature bolted onto existing tools and becomes the operating layer beneath all of them.
